statement.text:
Let ϕ be the Euler totient function. Does there exist a constant a > 0 such
that |Aut(G)| ⩾ ϕ(|G|)a
    a) for every finite group G?
    b) for every finite nilpotent group G?
   If such a constant a exists, then a ⩽ 40
                                          41 (J. González-Sánchez, A. Jaikin-Zapirain,
Forum Math. Sigma, 3, Article ID e7, 11 p., electronic only (2015)). Also cf. Archive
12.77.                                         J. González-Sánchez, A. Jaikin-Zapirain
